title: Cardiomyopathy: hypertrophic, ischemic or unspecified
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's cardiomyopathy (only that code).
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for heart condition.

HPI
Pt is a 56 y/o female presenting for f/u of obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. Pt reports she has been feeling well since last visit. Denies any episodes of syncope, palpitations, or significant exertional dyspnea. She reports good adherence to her current medication regimen. No new concerns reported today.

Medication List
Metoprolol 50mg BID

Exam
General: Pt alert and oriented x3, in no acute distress.
Vitals: BP 118/76, HR 64, RR 16, Temp 98.6F, SpO2 98% on RA.
CV: RRR, regular rhythm. S1, S2 heard. No murmurs, rubs, or gallops.
Lungs: CTAB.
Ext: No edema noted.

Assessment
1. Obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HOCM). Stable on current beta blocker.

Plan
1. Continue metoprolol 50mg BID.
2. Continue monitoring symptoms.
3. F/u in 6 months or PRN for increased symptoms.

Electronically signed,
